Name: (CP) Log Cabin to Dryad Tree with Fairy Ring
Author: warlockoftheabyss
Description:
[size=5]Transforms the log cabin into a damaged mystic tree in a fairy ring. As the cabin gets upgraded, the tree regrows and the mushroom circle sprouts. (Also the mushrooms change color with the seasons)[/size]

[size=5]I made this mod specifically for my me and my friend's stardew valley session where I am roleplaying a tree spirit on their grandfather's farm who lives in a chopped down mystic tree. I'm really only posting it here so its easier for my friend to get the files.[/size]

[size=5]But hey, if anyone else does have any interest in this, feel free to download :)[/size]
